ModMetaData.name: DBH Animal Water Source Fix
ModMetaData.author: Allen / ChatGPT
ModMetaData.description: RimWorld 1.5 compatibility fix for Dubs Bad Hygiene animal drinking. When DBH selects an inventory thirst-water item for an animal, this patch asks DBH's own ClosestSanitation.FindBestDrink selector whether a usable basin/trough is available. If DBH returns a basin, the inventory Ingest job is replaced with DBHDrinkFromBasin. If no usable basin is found, DBH's original inventory-water job is left unchanged. No global tick scanning and no Pawn_JobTracker patching.
